tldr: Mercury through the 6th house brings focus to work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance.
body: Mercury transiting the 6th house activates work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports daily systems and practical support: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or overwork or neglecting the body.
advice: Name the details in the 6th house deliberately. Work with work routines, health, service, labor, and maintenance without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
